candidates: When writing GitHub Actions conditions to detect or skip fork PRs, use `github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork != true` rather than comparing `github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository`. The `full_name` comparison can silently misbehave when `head.repo` is null (e.g., the originating fork was later deleted), while the boolean `fork` property is the purpose-built, null-safe alternative. This pattern is already established in `trigger-circle-ci-workflow.yml` and should be used consistently across all workflow files.
